name: Impressive Strike (Combat)
body:
You always make the most out of your critical strikes, aiming for the deadliest places on a target.

Prerequisite: Sneak attack class feature

Benefit: When you score a critical hit against a target, you deal sneak attack damage in addition to damage from your critical hit. Your critical multiplier applies only to your normal damage, not to your sneak attack damage. This feat does not increase your sneak attack damage. It simply allows you to sneak attack when you otherwise could not.
